summary: iter122 — Integration Center backend + frontend end-to-end testing. Found and FIXED a critical FastAPI route-ordering bug in /app/backend/routes/integrations/__init__.py that made Asset Mapping, Employee Mapping, Sync Logs, and Error Logs tabs all 404 ('Unknown provider'). Cause: register_config_routes() was called FIRST, so its parametric '/admin/integrations/{provider}' route swallowed the literal-string paths '/admin/integrations/asset-mappings', '/sync-logs', '/error-logs', and '/employee-mappings' before the more-specific routers got a chance to register. Re-ordered registrations so mappings + logs + imports_exports register BEFORE config. After fix, all 23 backend tests pass (auth gate · overview · demo toggle round-trip · events demo-mode stitching of 3 motive + 3 maintainx rows · empty-state when demo disabled · mappings · sync/error logs · CSV import for motive_vehicles · 4 CSV exports). Frontend smoke confirmed AdminShell sidebar Integrations nav · AdminHub IntegrationHealthCard · all 8 IC tabs load clean (no Unknown provider toasts) · ic-motive-demo toggle · ic-status-motive + ic-status-maintainx cards · HrHub health+events cards · ShopHub new Integrations tab with health+maintainx-events cards. SafetyHub mounts not verified in this run because /safety-portal redirects to safety login when admin token is the only credential present (admin token does not satisfy X-Safety-Token gate, by design); code inspection of SafetyHub.jsx mounts both testids correctly.

rca of the issue: Route precedence in FastAPI is strict declaration-order — first match wins. config.py registers GET '/admin/integrations/{provider}' (with str path-param). Calling register_config_routes BEFORE register_mapping_routes/register_log_routes meant the parametric route captured every '/admin/integrations/<anything-without-a-slash>' GET, including the literal-segment paths declared later. The handler then validates `provider not in {'motive','maintainx'}` and raises 404 'Unknown provider'. Frontend rendered the toast verbatim. Fix: register the more-specific routers (mappings, logs, imports_exports) BEFORE the wildcarded config router so FastAPI walks them first. Verified by re-running 23 pytest cases (all green) and clicking through every IC tab in the browser (no error toasts).
